label: rc-soak-v2-3647-smoke3

fixed_item_pair_per_observation_window.injection: At observation entry, two sequential validated vanilla writes; no atomic pair claim or refeeding.

conditions.observer: one serial RCON issuer; no sidecar RCON

measurement.attempts: FE/water each haveceil(seconds/feed_period) rounds with raw actual acceptance and partial rejections. Every steady window injects one32+32 ITEM pair, warmup none; no refeeding. A failed/uncertain pair is not a valid fixed-input window. SQL balances never prove input equality.
measurement.ITEM: Actual vanilla source chest variant count decrement -> actual external vanilla destination variant count increase/full batch; NeighborPump only. Components identify two workload variants, never event traces.
measurement.FE_FLUID: Synchronous native capability acceptance and actual extraction; aggregate overlapped ledgers only, no per-input E2E latency. Water type derives from fixed push-fluid native API; no physical fluid-container claim.
measurement.clock: All event bounds use this Python time.monotonic request/reply/read intervals; no cross-JVM nanoTime subtraction or world-save claim.
measurement.bounds: First decreased source read falls back to that variant item-replace request start. Target bounds include preceding zero/non-full reads, read order, polls and RCON uncertainty. Batch identity is finite because no second ITEM batch exists before full output, independent ITEM quiet guard and confirmed clear.
measurement.counter_window: Main cost captures before120s drive and after drive, before separately recorded final drain. Lifecycle cost also recorded through drain/quiet guard. Warmup/drain/setup separate. Capture requests/statement observer ends retained.
measurement.assets: Independent variant/FE/mB ledgers, source counts, external outputs and zero local/SQL checks. SQL allocation/WAL/local mirrors never added as assets; different units never summed.
measurement.observer: No concurrent RCON clients. Shared Minecraft console reply buffer has no business nonce despite protocol IDs; every raw body retained, chest coordinates/strict components validated. RCON spans, guard SQL spans, polling lateness and actual phase duration recorded; driver-limited results are not capacity.
measurement.native_validation: Offline parser/math checks do not validate Minecraft/component command syntax or performance; --execute must produce real completed guarded windows.
measurement.revision: Inherited launch-selected class/resource/JAR manifests plus PID/world/session/epoch. Operator revision and checkout are labels, not loaded-code proof. Rehash at end.
measurement.config: Verified launch config path; start/end config-file hashes and only allowlisted observed transfer flags retained. Current file bytes/flags alone do not prove old runtime support or startup-loaded values.
measurement.barriers: One fixed ITEM pair per steady window drains and remains zero for2.2s before its confirmed external chest outputs are cleared. Warmup/final phases drain all three resources and all owned chests; timeout/failure keeps assets. Old324s scanner waiting stays visible, even when120s ITEM output is0.
measurement.metrics: Optional instrumented counter differences are actual counters; baseline WAL remains UNMEASURED. local_credit_publications includes cross delivery. Native local_input/output_units may mix resource units: not external business throughput/assets. Mod/MC end rings cannot establish phase-wide MSPT/TPS or p95.
measurement.schedule: No catch-up mutation bursts: late/skipped feed opportunities retained. Duration cannot be shortened for pass.
measurement.item_scope: Small stable CUSTOM_NAME distinguishes A/B; identical fixed8x512ASCII CUSTOM_DATA is representative4KiB component content, not maximum payload. No per-event component changes. ITEM OFF until both staged stacks validate completely; unknown/failed staging retains stock and requests OFF.
measurement.item_input_clock: Initial real32-item chest write starts the saved input bound;16 subsequent component field writes and source validation happen while ITEM OFF. These setup costs are included in initial-stock-to-output bounds. Source-decrement bounds begin after complete component staging.
measurement.trace: All raw RCON and guarded SQL records spill to bounded events.jsonl with absolute stream indexes; report holds only a recent ring.
measurement.WAL_files: Only this run's endpoint ctj/pending paths read. Atomic replacement may occur between independent SQL/WAL reads; hashes are observations, never additional assets or proof of disk power-loss durability.
measurement.process: Serial /proc and short jstat -gc/-gcutil observations every30s. Their request spans and overhead are saved. Heap samples and cumulative GC deltas are not a pause distribution.
measurement.process_boundaries: Regular scheduled samples plus explicitly post-feed terminal read. Per-process GC/CPU deltas use actual first/last read spans, which can exceed the input window slightly.
measurement.main_thread: With --probe-manifest, verified agent exports measure every completed instrumented Runtime.tick/tickServer call and actual tick-start TPS, with complete sparse histograms. tickServer body includes hooks; waits outside that method are represented by separate tick-start intervals. Without it these whole-window values remain UNMEASURED; mod/MC rolling timing snapshots alone are diagnostic.
measurement.probe_boundaries: After warmup/drain, start(trace=False) controls take effect at the next tick entry, before initial counters. Fixed export follows fixed counter_end and is copied by the daemon from completed calls; it includes the actual recorded control/counter edge delay. Stop follows real drain/quiet and final counters, sealing at a completed tick boundary. Fixed prefixes have millisecond-scale edge observations, not a promised exact3600s cutoff; use retained command spans/each JVM's own anchors. Never subtract raw nanoTime across JVMs.
measurement.low_flow: One outstanding1024FE probe per cold channel. Acceptance-to-observed extraction bounds use this observer's monotonic clock; a missed scheduled probe remains a coverage failure.
measurement.large_RCON: Only this driver gathers bounded multipart Items replies using a same-connection requestID103 ct_test pid barrier after requestID102. Barrier traffic and raw replies are recorded; historical readers/parsers unchanged.
measurement.backpressure: Extraction withheld only for fresh owned FE endpoints; actual RX capacity or positive-owned-credit bound recorded distinctly, then real extraction must resume.
measurement.cleanup: No block/ticket/SQL/WAL cleanup. Successful fully drained endpoints set OFF; failures leave current fixture state for review.

data.scope: Explicit test agent. All complete tickServer calls (normal or exceptional) in this window, including Neo Pre/Post; fixed bounded histograms, not rolling samples. Named nested method spans are inclusive/exclusive, not all summed. No game objects or file IO on server-thread probe callbacks.

clock.mapping_limit: Same-host shared OS realtime anchors, 1ms quantization plus observed drift. Never subtract raw nanoTime from different JVMs.

data.histogram_precision: Upper bounds, <=3.125% width above32ns; count/sum/max exact; each window is bounded to180000 ticks.

mod_roots.scope: Per complete tickServer on that thread: union of outermost selected mod method intervals, including zero on idle ticks. Nested scopes counted once. Generator is not a mod root, but selected children are. Outside-tick main-thread and non-main-thread roots are separate per-call wall histograms, never assigned to a nearby tick. This is wall time, not CPU time or all mod work.
mod_roots.coverage_limits: Explicit whitelist only. Includes actual TesseractBlockEntity.saveAdditional and selected compat.changed/AE insert-extract-inventory/GT energy mutation/Mek chemical-heat mutation entries. Uninstrumented GUI, other save/load hooks, other compat callbacks/getters, method prefixes/suffixes, and outside-tick work are excluded from the per-tick sum. Optional compat hooks with no actual calls remain unexercised; transformed_classes records actual loaded descriptors.
mod_roots.logical_tick_cycle_scope: Main-thread selected mod root union from one tickServer start to the next, including main-thread roots outside tickServer. Zero-work cycles count zero. A fixed live snapshot has one fewer completed cycle than completed tick frames; the current incomplete cycle is excluded. Stop seals at the next tick start, flushes the final complete cycle, and excludes that new tick frame; sealed cycles must equal tick frames. No raw cross-JVM clock subtraction and no claim of uninstrumented mod work or CPU time.

data.limits: Methods crossing window cutoffs/exceptional returns are not backend latency observations. Server/runtime samples include all completed instrumented calls; exceptional returns are separately counted. Calls crossing the cutoffs are excluded. Heap/GC/SQL asset counters are measured separately. Tracing copies identifiers/amounts only on the original calling thread.

Heap/GC/SQL asset counters are measured separately. Tracing copies identifiers/amounts only on the original calling thread.

data.scope: Explicit test agent. All complete tickServer calls (normal or exceptional) in this window, including Neo Pre/Post; fixed bounded histograms, not rolling samples. Named nested method spans are inclusive/exclusive, not all summed. No game objects or file IO on server-thread probe callbacks.

clock.mapping_limit: Same-host shared OS realtime anchors, 1ms quantization plus observed drift. Never subtract raw nanoTime from different JVMs.

data.histogram_precision: Upper bounds, <=3.125% width above32ns; count/sum/max exact; each window is bounded to180000 ticks.

mod_roots.scope: Per complete tickServer on that thread: union of outermost selected mod method intervals, including zero on idle ticks. Nested scopes counted once. Generator is not a mod root, but selected children are. Outside-tick main-thread and non-main-thread roots are separate per-call wall histograms, never assigned to a nearby tick. This is wall time, not CPU time or all mod work.
mod_roots.coverage_limits: Explicit whitelist only. Includes actual TesseractBlockEntity.saveAdditional and selected compat.changed/AE insert-extract-inventory/GT energy mutation/Mek chemical-heat mutation entries. Uninstrumented GUI, other save/load hooks, other compat callbacks/getters, method prefixes/suffixes, and outside-tick work are excluded from the per-tick sum. Optional compat hooks with no actual calls remain unexercised; transformed_classes records actual loaded descriptors.
mod_roots.logical_tick_cycle_scope: Main-thread selected mod root union from one tickServer start to the next, including main-thread roots outside tickServer. Zero-work cycles count zero. A fixed live snapshot has one fewer completed cycle than completed tick frames; the current incomplete cycle is excluded. Stop seals at the next tick start, flushes the final complete cycle, and excludes that new tick frame; sealed cycles must equal tick frames. No raw cross-JVM clock subtraction and no claim of uninstrumented mod work or CPU time.

Credit publications include cross delivery. Native local_input/output_units may mix resource units and are diagnostics, not external throughput/asset totals.
